subject.title: [Feature]: Add safe UI diagnostics to the Control UI debug page

question: Which UI/browser/display/media facts may the authenticated Debug page expose, and should the first implementation include copy/export support?
rationale: The code shape is clear, but the durable product decision is the privacy boundary for diagnostic facts that could identify a browser, display, environment, or media setup.

options.title: Narrow allowlisted table
options.body: Expose only coarse, support-safe facts such as secure context, viewport class, DPR bucket, color/reduced-motion preferences, capability booleans, and media-device availability/counts without labels or IDs.

options.title: Diagnostics view without export
options.body: Show the table on the authenticated Debug page but defer copy/export until redaction and support-sharing expectations are proven.

options.title: Defer to broader diagnostics design
options.body: Keep this issue open behind the broader diagnostics/security decision and avoid adding a standalone table until the shared diagnostic schema is settled.

recommendation.title: Narrow allowlisted table
recommendation.body: Expose only coarse, support-safe facts such as secure context, viewport class, DPR bucket, color/reduced-motion preferences, capability booleans, and media-device availability/counts without labels or IDs.

likelyOwner.reason: He opened this focused proposal and has the strongest history on the Debug surface and product/security boundary.
